title: Everyone Here Is Tied to a Monster. Mine Is Running From Me. (Part 1)
summary: With forty townspeople hanging from his ankles, Fold discovers the enormous creature on his wrist string is trying to get away from him.
frame_0: Fold's glowing wrist string leads up into the cloud over a field. People hang from his legs and a vast winged shape strains upward above the town.
package_differences: Jake requested one moving shot through the closing question. The Flashloop card follows at the specified time.
